Definition
[Dirichlet heat kernel] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0421 1. appe:1.12\group Heat Kernels

On a compact manifold with boundary, a Dirichlet heat kernel is a fundamental solution in the interior, continuous up to the boundary, and zero when its first argument lies on the boundary.
